scope: Release-tooling test portability and diagnostic logging only; application code, generated-version rules, algorithms and package version unchanged.

findings.issue: Canonical and symlink temporary paths were compared as literal strings
findings.fix: Resolve the expected executable path; add an explicit linked-directory test including spaces and the .exe suffix.

findings.issue: Rapid fixture rewrites could occur within the same second; make with whole-second timestamp comparison retained the earlier probe
findings.fix: Wait for the next observed whole-second timestamp before a fixture edit and the no-op check; retain normal make and exact version assertions. No forced build or generated-file touch.

findings.issue: An additional Linux APT test fixture wrote an unescaped file URI when TMPDIR contained spaces
findings.fix: Construct a percent-encoded absolute file URI in that test fixture; production APT collector unchanged.

environment.make_coarse: GNU Make 3.81, built from GNU source with ac_cv_struct_st_mtim_nsec=no
environment.make_build_flags: -O2 -D__alloca=alloca -D__stat=stat -Dbsd_signal=signal (host compatibility only; fixture tooling not distributed)

checks.version_incremental_current_make: passed; beta.2 -> beta.5 -> beta.6 -> stable; unchanged version leaves object untouched
checks.version_incremental_coarse_make: passed; same exact-version and no-op checks, paths contain spaces

full_release_suite.skip_reason: Homebrew Ruby query class requires Ruby, absent on this Linux host
full_release_suite.environment: coarse make plus symlink TMPDIR containing spaces

checks.additional_run_note: The first all-tests run with a spaced TMPDIR revealed the APT test-fixture URI issue recorded above; the final complete run passed after correcting that fixture.
